<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_plng_att_core.CostPlanBreakdownForFinancialAttributes</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>CostPlanBreakdownForFinancialAttributes</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var CostPlanBreakdownForFinancialAttributes = Class.create();
CostPlanBreakdownForFinancialAttributes.prototype = Object.extendsObject(CostPlanForFinancialAttributes, {

    createBreakDowns: function() {
        const savedExchangeRates = this.getExchangeRateObjects('^exchange_rate!=0');
		const topTask = this.gr?.isValidField('top_task') ? this.gr?.getValue('top_task') : '';
        const {
            laborCosts,
            fiscalPeriodSysIds
        } = this._getLaborCostAndFiscalSysIds(topTask ? topTask : this.gr?.task , this.gr?.task?.sys_class_name);

        const exchangeRates = this._getExchangeRatesForFiscalPeriods(fiscalPeriodSysIds);
        let i, functionalCurrency = this.getFunctionalCurrency();

        if (this.projectCurrency) {
            const projectCurrencyExchangeRates = new global.ProjectCurrencyUtil().getProjectExchangeRatesFromFiscalPeriodsSysIds(this.gr.currency, this.projectCurrency, fiscalPeriodSysIds, exchangeRates);
            for (i = 0; i < fiscalPeriodSysIds.length; ++i) {
                this._createBreakDownRecord(fiscalPeriodSysIds[i], laborCosts[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRatesSysIds[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRates[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRateDates[i], savedExchangeRates, functionalCurrency, projectCurrencyExchangeRates.exchangeRatesSysIds[i], projectCurrencyExchangeRates.exchangeRates[i], this.projectCurrency);
            }
        } else if (this.demandCurrency) {
            const demandCurrencyExchangeRates = global.MultiCurrencyUtil.getCurrencyExchangeRatesFromFiscalPeriodsSysIds(this.gr.currency, this.demandCurrency, fiscalPeriodSysIds, exchangeRates);
            for (i = 0; i < fiscalPeriodSysIds.length; ++i) {
                this._createBreakDownRecord(fiscalPeriodSysIds[i], laborCosts[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRatesSysIds[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRates[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRateDates[i], savedExchangeRates, functionalCurrency, demandCurrencyExchangeRates.exchangeRatesSysIds[i], demandCurrencyExchangeRates.exchangeRates[i], this.demandCurrency);

            }
        } else {
            for (i = 0; i < fiscalPeriodSysIds.length; ++i) {
                this._createBreakDownRecord(fiscalPeriodSysIds[i], laborCosts[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRatesSysIds[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRates[i], exchangeRates.exchangeRateDates[i], savedExchangeRates, functionalCurrency);
            }
        }

    },

    _getLaborCostAndFiscalSysIds: function(taskId = '', taskSysClassName = '') {
        const fmAttributes = new FinancialMgmtAttributes();
        const attributes = fmAttributes.getAttributes(taskId, taskSysClassName);
        const {
            fiscalPeriodSysIds,
            fiscalPeriodDateRanges
        } = this._getFiscalPeriodDatesAndSysIds();

        const laborCosts = this._getLaborCostByDateRanges(attributes, fiscalPeriodDateRanges);
        return {
            fiscalPeriodSysIds,
            laborCosts
        };
    },

    _getFiscalPeriodDatesAndSysIds: function() {
        const startFiscalPeriod = this.gr.start_fiscal_period;
        const endFiscalPeriod = this.gr.end_fiscal_period;

        const fiscalPeriods = this.financialApi.getFiscalPeriods(startFiscalPeriod.fiscal_start_date_time, endFiscalPeriod.fiscal_end_date_time);
        const fiscalPeriodSysIds = [];
        const fiscalPeriodDateRanges = [];
        while (fiscalPeriods.next()) {
            fiscalPeriodSysIds.push(fiscalPeriods.getValue('sys_id'));
            const periodStart = new GlideScheduleDateTime(fiscalPeriods.getDisplayValue('start_date_time')).getGlideDateTime().getDate();
            const periodEnd = new GlideScheduleDateTime(fiscalPeriods.getDisplayValue('end_date_time')).getGlideDateTime().getDate();
            const periodDateRange = new global.RMDateRange(periodStart, periodEnd);
            fiscalPeriodDateRanges.push(periodDateRange);
        }
        return {
            fiscalPeriodSysIds,
            fiscalPeriodDateRanges
        };
    },

    _getLaborCostByDateRanges: function(attributes, dateRanges) {
        let costs = new Array(dateRanges.length).fill(0);
        //This is to handle an edge case when cost plan is created from time card, There is a Resource plan available but the cost plan is 
        // not yet available (not synced), in those cases, it is going to fall under Resource plan based cost plan but we will keep the cost of breakdown 0
        if(this.gr.unit_cost == 0) {
            return costs;
        }
        let totalCost = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < dateRanges.length; ++i) {
            const dateRange = dateRanges[i];
            //OPEN QUESTION: How to know which one to read planned_hours or planned_hours
            // if (costType === 'planned_cost')
            // totalCost = this._calculateResourcePlanRequestedCost(dateRange, resPlanId);
            // else if(costType === 'allocated_cost')
            totalCost = this._calculateLaborCost(attributes, dateRange);
            costs[i] = totalCost;
        }
        return costs;
    },

    _calculateLaborCost: function(attributes, dateRange) {
        let total = 0;
        const resAlloc = new GlideAggregate('resource_allocation_daily');

        this._addAttributeInQuery(attributes, this.gr, this.gr.task, resAlloc, this.gr.task.sys_class_name);
        resAlloc.addQuery('date', '>=', dateRange.start);
        resAlloc.addQuery('date', '<=', dateRange.end);
        resAlloc.addAggregate('SUM', 'allocated_cost');
        resAlloc.setGroup(false);
        resAlloc.query();

        if (resAlloc.next()) {
            const sum = parseFloat(resAlloc.getAggregate('SUM', 'allocated_cost'));
            if (global.JSUtil.notNil(sum) && !isNaN(sum))
                total = sum;
        }
        return total;
    },

    getCostsByFiscalPeriod: function() {
        const topTask = this.gr?.isValidField('top_task') ? this.gr?.getValue('top_task') : '';
        const {
            laborCosts
        } = this._getLaborCostAndFiscalSysIds(topTask ? topTask : this.gr?.task , this.gr?.task?.sys_class_name);
        return laborCosts;
    },

    type: 'CostPlanBreakdownForFinancialAttributes'
});]]></script>
